F002 escalation: redirect_uri bypass at registration -- 20+ techniques tested: external domains (evil.com https/http), custom schemes (lucis://), data: URIs, javascript: URIs, userinfo tricks (localhost@evil.com, localhost:80@evil.com), null bytes (localhost%00@evil.com), fragment confusion (localhost#@evil.com), subdomain tricks (localhost.evil.com, localhostevil.com, 127.0.0.1.evil.com), credentials syntax (evil:evil@localhost), IPv6-mapped external (::ffff:8.8.8.8), 0.0.0.0, path traversal backslash. ALL non-loopback rejected. Alternative loopback representations accepted (decimal 2130706433, octal 0177.0.0.1, hex 0x7f000001, URL-encoded, IPv6 long [0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]) but all resolve to loopback. Non-loopback in alternative forms (decimal 134744072=8.8.8.8, hex 0x08080808, octal 010.0.0.1) correctly rejected. Validation is robust.

F002 escalation: scope/grant downgrade at registration -- Registration ALWAYS forces: scope=openid (drops profile/email/address/health:read/care:read/orders:read/health:write/care:write), grant_types=[authorization_code] (drops client_credentials), token_endpoint_auth_method=none (ignores client_secret_post/basic). No client_secret ever issued. Multiple redirect_uris with one external rejected.

F002 escalation: client_credentials at OIDC token endpoint -- Token endpoint internally supports client_credentials (error: Expected authorization_code | client_credentials). All registered clients have method=none and no secret. Empty secret: 'Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters'. Fabricated secret: 'Client authentication failed'. Cannot bypass.
F002 escalation: OIDC client management -- No GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on /oidc/register/{client_id} (all 404). Only POST+OPTIONS. Clients cannot be read, updated, or deleted.
F002 escalation: token introspection/revocation -- /oidc/token/introspect and /oidc/token/revoke both 404. No endpoints exist.

F002 escalation: token confusion -- OIDC (api.lucis.life kid=sig-2026-01) vs Clerk (clerk.lucis.life kid=ins_2rxFlXG6QXTpPPrJHC3ZxSOXdiS): different RSA keys, no cross-verification. Catalog token (lucis_ opaque, www.lucis.life) rejected by OIDC userinfo and MCP and api member endpoints. All services properly isolated.

F002 escalation: MCP endpoints -- Only /health (200), GET|POST /v1/mcp (401), /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (200). /v1/tools, /v1/resources, /v1/prompts, /v1/sse, /v1/messages, /docs, /swagger, /openapi.json, /.well-known/mcp.json all 404. Properly requires Clerk OAuth Bearer.

F002 escalation: Clerk dynamic registration -- Disabled (feature_requires_dynamic_oauth_client_registration). Device auth flow needs client_id. client_id_metadata_document_supported=true but URL-based client_ids return 'could not be resolved'. Timing analysis: ~0.21s for both resolving and non-resolving domains = no outbound fetch, no SSRF.

F002 escalation: Clerk authorize without client_id -- Accepts initial /oauth/authorize and redirects to /oauth/authorize/continue, but continue step returns 401 'The requested OAuth 2.0 Client does not exist'. Deferred but functional validation.

F002 escalation: OIDC authorize deferred validation -- app.lucis.life/oidc/authorize 307 to sign-in before validating redirect_uri/scope. api.lucis.life/oidc/authorize 401 (requires auth first). Cannot test mismatch without active session.

F002 escalation: client enumeration -- authorization_code grant: 'invalid_grant' for existing clients vs 'invalid_client' for non-existing. Differential but UUIDs not enumerable. client_credentials uniform. Non-UUID: 'Invalid UUID'.

F002 escalation: PKCE -- code_challenge_methods_supported: S256. Authorize accepts with and without code_challenge. Token returns same error with/without code_verifier for invalid codes. Cannot confirm enforcement without valid auth code.
F002 escalation: redirect_uri binding -- redirect_uri REQUIRED at token exchange (error when omitted). Code is bound to URI.

Deep injection: Stored XSS via referral firstName -- /v1/public/referral-links/{code} returns JSON (content-type: application/json, x-content-type-options:nosniff). referrerFirstName is Peter for PETBJO7NDV. Deep injection: SSTI on all endpoints -- Tested {{7*7}}, ${7*7}, <%= 7*7 %>, Jinja2 class traversal on /v1/public/codes/validate, /v1/public/referral-links/, /v1/public/gift-cards/, /v1/public/gift-campaigns/. All treated as literal strings. NestJS does not use server-side templates for JSON API responses. No SSTI.

Deep injection: Prototype pollution on API -- __proto__ and constructor.prototype in JSON body tested on /v1/public/checkout/calculate, /v1/public/codes/validate, /oidc/register. NestJS Zod validation strips unknown properties. codes/validate isValid remains false despite __proto__.isValid=true. OIDC scope remains openid despite __proto__.scope escalation. Nested __proto__ in basket items also ineffective. Not exploitable.

Deep injection: Prototype pollution on CMS -- POST /api/articles with __proto__ in body returns explicit error: Object contains forbidden prototype property. Strapi has built-in prototype pollution protection.

Deep injection: CRLF/header injection -- Tested on /v1/public/codes/validate, /v1/public/referral-links/, /oidc/register (client_name with CRLF). No injected headers appear in responses. CRLF characters stored as literals in OIDC client_name but not interpreted as header separators. NestJS and Cloudflare both handle CRLF properly.

Deep injection: Host header attacks -- Mismatched Host header returns 403 from Cloudflare on all proxied hosts. X-Forwarded-Host on api.lucis.life accepted but ignored (response unchanged). X-Forwarded-Host on clerk.lucis.life returns Invalid host (Clerk validates). X-Forwarded-Host on app.lucis.life accepted but no observable effect. No host header injection possible.

Deep injection: HTTP parameter pollution -- Duplicate query params on /v1/public/services?country=FR&country=GB returns 400. Content-Type confusion: JSON body with x-www-form-urlencoded returns 400. Form body with application/json returns 400. Query+body overlap: body takes precedence. Properly handled.
Deep injection: JSONP not supported -- callback and jsonp query parameters tested on public endpoints. Parameters ignored. Response always JSON.

Deep injection: Content-type negotiation -- Accept: text/html and Accept: application/xml both ignored by API. Response always application/json with x-content-type-options:nosniff. No MIME-sniffing XSS.

Deep injection: Reflected XSS in API errors -- 404 error for /v1/public/<script>... returns URL-encoded path in JSON. codes/validate reflects XSS as literal in originalCode JSON field. Register invalid JSON error partially reflects input in JSON error. All non-exploitable due to JSON content-type + nosniff.
Deep injection: Reflected XSS on app/www -- app.lucis.life URL paths are URL-encoded in redirects. www.lucis.life 404 page does not reflect URL path. No reflected XSS found.
Deep injection: XSS in Accept-Language and Referer headers -- Tested on multiple endpoints. Headers not reflected in responses.
Deep injection: Clerk WAF blocks XSS in OAuth params -- XSS payloads in client_id or error_description to clerk.lucis.life triggers Cloudflare WAF 403. Good defense-in-depth.
Deep injection: OIDC token error messages -- XSS in authorization code returns generic error. No reflection of input.
Deep injection: Tax ID validation -- countryPrefix returns first 2 chars of taxId input. JSON content-type. Not exploitable.

Deep injection: Unicode normalization -- Fullwidth angle brackets treated as normal text. UTF-8 overlong encoding rejected. Null bytes passed through but codes returned invalid. No normalization bypass.
Deep injection: Input length validation -- codes/validate enforces max 64 chars on code (Zod). OIDC client_name max 100 chars. Proper input length validation.
Deep injection: CMS injection -- Strapi /api/articles with filters returns 403 (locked). GraphQL returns 405. No injection surface on CMS.

findings.cwe: CWE-307 Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts
findings.summary: No account lockout on password authentication. 100+ failed password attempts do not trigger lockout, suspension, or CAPTCHA. Rate limiting exists (HTTP 429, Retry-After: 60s) but allows ~54% of rapid requests through and resets with new sign-in attempts. Email code verification properly locks after 3 attempts, but password verification has no limit.
